These tiny RAR4 and solid RAR5 fixtures contain generated gradient PNGs,
one sky rule, a legacy item texture, a crosshair and a UTF-8 author filename.
They were generated using rars 0.12.3 (RAR40 / RAR50, compressed, RAR50 solid)
and contain no resources copied from user packs. Both wrap the pack in one folder.

`tests/rar_import.rs` also constructs stored RAR4 records independently to test
unsafe names, links, encrypted/split members and failed integrity verification.
